_comment: Starter autobattle presets — item 13 from the 2026-07-01 playtest backlog. 3 stances per starter job. Design rules: (1) survival-floor rules always sit above damage rules, (2) every costed-ability rule carries an mp_percent guard OR sits below a 0-cost MP-refill rule, so a preset can never burn a turn on an unaffordable ability, (3) prefer 1-2 conditions per rule for grid-editor readability, (4) only level-1 base-kit abilities — nothing level-gated that would fizzle for a fresh character.

templates.name: Defensive
templates.description: Cure poison, heal early, taunt the biggest threat on turn 1, recover AP when in debt.

templates.name: Balanced
templates.description: Cure poison, heal below half, Power Strike wounded enemies, attack.

templates.name: Aggressive
templates.description: Cleave crowds, Power Strike while MP lasts, only heal when nearly down.

templates.name: Defensive
templates.description: Emergency Sanatio Maior first, cleanse poison, heal early, Pray when MP runs dry, Defer between crises.

templates.name: Balanced
templates.description: Heal emergencies and poison, top allies up, Pray when dry, attack when the party is safe.

templates.name: Aggressive
templates.description: Battle cleric — heal only true emergencies, Protect self on turn 1, swing every other turn.

templates.name: Defensive
templates.description: Heal early, recover AP debt, Channel MP back, finish weak enemies with the staff to save MP.

templates.name: Balanced
templates.description: Fire at the squishiest target, Channel when dry, save MP on nearly-dead enemies.

templates.name: Aggressive
templates.description: Ignis Maior spam, double-cast burst with spare AP, Channel just enough to keep casting.

templates.name: Defensive
templates.description: Steal on turn 1, heal early, recover AP debt, chip away safely.

templates.name: Balanced
templates.description: Steal first, Backstab wounded enemies, heal below a third.

templates.name: Aggressive
templates.description: Double Backstab burst with spare AP, hunt the biggest threat, heal only at the brink.

templates.name: Defensive
templates.description: Battle Hymn on turn 1, keep the biggest threat asleep, Riff MP back for the party.

templates.name: Balanced
templates.description: Battle Hymn opener, Lullaby the biggest threat in crowds, Riff when MP dips, attack otherwise.

templates.name: Aggressive
templates.description: Hymn the party up, then double-strike with spare AP and keep swinging.

templates.name: Defensive
templates.description: Ward the party when anyone drops, patch yourself with a potion, recover AP from debt, then hold the line.

templates.name: Balanced
templates.description: Open with the ward, stun whoever hits hardest, keep AP above water, otherwise swing at the biggest threat.

templates.name: Aggressive
templates.description: Ward once when the party is hurt, then lead with Last Stand and Shield Bash; only defer in real AP debt.

templates.name: Defensive
templates.description: Blind the whole room on turn 1, vanish when it gets dangerous, drink before it gets worse, then cut whatever is left.

templates.name: Balanced
templates.description: Patch up first, finish anything wounded with a priority strike, otherwise step into the shadows so the next swing crits.

templates.name: Aggressive
templates.description: Shuriken any crowd, snipe the wounded before they act, set up a crit when the field is quiet, and never stop swinging.

templates.name: Defensive
templates.description: Trip the breaker before the market does, hedge the weakest ally early, and take the safe swing the rest of the time.

templates.name: Balanced
templates.description: Build a position while it is cheap, cash it the moment the band is worth it, and swing steel in between.

templates.name: Aggressive
templates.description: Leverage hard, overexpose them once, and hold the press until the band is Fractured — the biggest multiplier or nothing.
